notes: Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6b (litert-community/Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6b main 56fcb491, created 2026-09-28): the codec decoder, float16 weights, one call = 128 frames of codes -> 5.94 s of 44.1 kHz audio. Measured on the Galaxy S26 (SM-S942Q) with the LiteRT C API runner: one result per run, one runner process per run, on the fixtures of real codes and of silence (all-zero codes; the count is metrics.fixtures). On the GPU (ML Drift) this file computes wrong audio at the default precision and at FP32, on LiteRT 2.2.0 and 2.3.2 alike, with no error line; the cause was traced to the graph (a MUL of a runtime rank-2 operand with a [1,1,1024] constant that the GPU lays out differently from its rank-3 output, wrong at FP32 too; RMSNorm sums of squares above the float16 range; in T192 also the -1e9 attention mask) and fixed it in a rewrite whose CPU output is byte-identical to this file's; the rewrite is not this file and has no record here.
